prose: HackerTV is a Show HN project that turns Hacker News' most-recommended YouTube videos into 24/7 TV channels with a retro TV interface: channel up and down, number keys, a program guide, captions and theater mode. The page warns that durations are estimated until YouTube metadata loads, so some programs may run short or get cut off.
highlights: HN's most-recommended YouTube videos as always-on TV channels
Retro controls: channel surfing, guide, captions, fullscreen
basis: Short cache (479 chars of page UI text). Written from the page's interface description.
